parsed_output.analysis: The specification requires Power On to start in HumanDrivingMode, a front_distance > 10 move from HumanDrivingMode to the AutonomousMode composite, a return to HumanDrivingMode only when the AutonomousMode sub-machine is in its AutoFinal sub-state and a human steering command or brake press is received, and a Power Off transition to FinalState from the running system. The PlantUML model implements Power On correctly and models AutonomousMode as a composite with AutoNavigating and AutoFinal, but the Power Off and the return-to-human transitions are modeled at the wrong level / from the wrong source.

issues.issue: Power Off transition is sourced from the initial pseudo-state instead of from running states
issues.reason: Specification 5 says when power off the system will transit to final state from its current operating mode. The model only allows Power Off from [*] before any state is entered, so Power Off cannot be handled once the system is in HumanDrivingMode or AutonomousMode.

issues.issue: Return to HumanDrivingMode is defined on the composite AutonomousMode instead of on the AutoFinal sub-state
issues.reason: Specification 4 says transit to human driving mode when receive human steering cmd, brake pressed, in (auto final). The model makes the transition the exit of the whole AutonomousMode composite with the sub-state mentioned only as a textual guard. The transition should originate from the AutoFinal sub-state, e.g. AutoFinal --> HumanDrivingMode, and should not be enabled while the machine is in AutoNavigating.
issues.where: AutonomousMode --> HumanDrivingMode : Human Steering Cmd, Brake Pressed, in (AutoFinal)

issues.issue: Missing Power Off transitions from the active states to FinalState
issues.reason: Specification 5 requires the system to be able to go to final state on Power Off while operating in Human Driving or Autonomous mode. The model provides no such transitions, so once HumanDrivingMode or AutonomousMode is active Power Off is not modeled.
issues.where: HumanDrivingMode and AutonomousMode have no Power Off --> FinalState transition; only [*] --> FinalState : Power Off exists

system_prompt:
You are an experienced control-systems engineer reviewing a state machine model against the natural-language specification it was built from.

You are given two things, both complete and unmodified:
  1. The natural-language specification.
  2. A state machine model written in PlantUML.

Your task: identify the places where the model does not conform to the specification. Read the specification in full first, then read the model in full, then report what you find.

Report as many or as few issues as you actually find, and organize them however you judge best. For each issue, state what the non-conformance is, which part of the model it concerns, and why you consider it a non-conformance.

Write your findings in en-US. Return only the requested structured response.
